title: Agent App views (viewsVersion 1)
description: How the app is shown where its web page is not: the CraftBot terminal edition and `agent-app view`. A catalog of semantic blocks; every data source and every action names a declared operation, so everything a person sees or does is reachable through the app's ops. The gate checks the references (agent-app/view/src/validate.ts): sources must be read ops (GET or readOnly), actions must name declared ops, keys are one character, unique per screen and not one of the navigation keys (q j k g h l c r J G s t p o x v y n).

home.description: id of the first screen (default: the first in the list).

params.description: Fixed params. In row actions a value "$row.<field>" takes that field of the selected row.

format.description: money:/pointer reads the currency from the source; money:JPY fixes it.

priority.description: 0 = always shown; higher numbers drop first on narrow terminals.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the source op's result ('' = the whole result).

block.description: metrics {items:[{label, value: pointer, format}]}, keyvalue {value, fields}, table {rows, columns, rowActions}, list {items, primary, secondary, rowActions}, bars {series, x, y}, sparkline {series, y, x}, text {value | text}, auto {value} (laid out by its shape).

refreshOn.description: Collections whose changes refresh this screen (default: all).
